description.english_blurb:
Bram Stoker's 1897 masterpiece of Gothic horror, presented unabridged.

Told through the journals, letters and diaries of those who hunted him, Dracula follows solicitor Jonathan Harker from a remote Transylvanian castle to the streets of London, where Mina Harker, Dr. John Seward and Professor Van Helsing race to stop a predator who has crossed the sea to find them.

This recording gives each narrator their own distinct voice, so the novel's overlapping accounts read as the chorus of testimony Stoker intended.
